versions.content: The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyTriggerTransmit Services from the Rte_LdComCbkTriggerTransmit callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has LdComTxTrig- gerTransmit configured [SWS_LDCOM_00047]. AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].
